## ✨ Highlights

- 🔒 **The Controller's updater on Docker Compose v5.6.1**: the Compose binary in the Controller's image was built by its project with an older Go, whose standard library carried five high and two medium vulnerabilities (`net/http`, `net/textproto`, `crypto/tls`, `html/template`). v5.6.1 is built without them.
- 🐧 **Linux 7.2.12 and 6.18.58**: both kernel tracks follow their upstream stable releases.
- 🪶 **Lighter pages**: a node's page loads the Controller's node app once for every node, and the docs' screenshots weigh a third on an ordinary screen.

## 🔒 Security

For **the Controller's image** - its updater, `janus-controller-updater`, which runs Docker Compose to replace the Controller; nothing changes for the nodes, janusctl or the Controller's own server:

- **Docker Compose v5.6.1** (was v5.6.0), the release binary its project publishes, checked against its published sha256 and GitHub's digest. Fixed, in the Go standard library it was built with:
  - 🟠 high: `net/http` - [CVE-2026-56866](https://pkg.go.dev/vuln/GO-2026-6605) (client connection desynchronization after a refused `CONNECT`), [CVE-2026-94439](https://pkg.go.dev/vuln/GO-2026-6613) (server connection desynchronization after a 2xx `CONNECT`), [CVE-2026-78667](https://pkg.go.dev/vuln/GO-2026-6609) (no limit on the size of parsed `Range` headers); `net/textproto`, `mime/multipart` - [CVE-2026-94440](https://pkg.go.dev/vuln/GO-2026-6608) (memory limit bypassed parsing MIME headers); `crypto/tls` - [CVE-2026-97031](https://pkg.go.dev/vuln/GO-2026-6607) (malformed ECH outer extension references);
  - 🟡 medium: `html/template` - [CVE-2026-94448](https://pkg.go.dev/vuln/GO-2026-6599), [CVE-2026-97030](https://pkg.go.dev/vuln/GO-2026-6600);
  - and [CVE-2026-111943](https://pkg.go.dev/vuln/GO-2026-6809) (`crypto/x509`), which v2026.10.21 fixed in Janus's own binaries.

  The updater has no network (`network_mode: none`): Compose only speaks to the Docker daemon over its socket. The same version, the same commands.

## ⚙️ Node

- **Linux 7.2.12** for the default kernel track (was 7.2.11) and **6.18.58** for the longterm one (was 6.18.57), each from its signature-checked source, the configuration unchanged. No known vulnerability among the files Janus's kernels build.

## 🖥️ Controller

- **A node's page shares its code with the others** ([#216](https://github.com/swenske/Janus/pull/216)): the node app's scripts and styles were served under each node's own path, so a browser fetched and kept the same ~320 KB (100 KB compressed) once per node it opened. They now live at one path, `/node-app/`, cached once and for good (`immutable`); each node's page and its API stay where they were.

## 📖 Docs

- **Screenshots for the screen they're on** ([#217](https://github.com/swenske/Janus/pull/217)): every screenshot is taken for a high-density screen; an ordinary one now gets a version at its own resolution - all of them weigh 1.3 MB instead of 3.3 MB -, in the docs and on the landing page.

## 🧪 Tests and tooling

- **The image build's tests in nine jobs** ([#215](https://github.com/swenske/Janus/pull/215)): the Controller's self-update, libvirt and Terraform tests left the Secure Boot and bare-metal job, the longest of every run.
- **An image built once per job** ([#218](https://github.com/swenske/Janus/pull/218)): each of the thirty QEMU tests of a job rebuilt the root filesystem and the disk image; they are now made again only when something they're made of changed - a test's image is a copy of the job's in about a second and a half.
- **The Controller's self-update test picks its ports below the kernel's ephemeral range** ([#213](https://github.com/swenske/Janus/pull/213)): v2026.10.21's build failed once on a port another runner instance had just been given.
- [v2026.10.21's lab campaign](https://github.com/swenske/Janus/blob/main/docs/pre-release-tests/v2026.10.21.md): a screen-only machine built by the image factory, registered on its own, each line of its screen once.
- Dependencies: go-jose 4.1.6 (Let's Encrypt's client: a JWK's RSA modulus capped at 4096 bits), React 19.3.1, lucide-react 1.59, Astro 7.4, Mermaid 12.2, Playwright 1.64.1, markdownlint-cli2 0.24 with markdown-it 15.0.3 and Node 24.22.1, a security release (the docs' build only), OpenTofu 1.13.2 (the Terraform provider's tests).

## ⚠️ Upgrade notes

- **The Controller**: update it - its updater replaces itself with the new image's on the next update, as usual.
- **Nodes**: the usual A/B update, for the new kernels.
- **A page of a node kept open across the Controller's update** loads the node app from its new path on the next reload.
